items.title: Enforcement of the vacant properties ordinance
items.summary: The Director of Inspectional Services will update the committee on how the city enforces its vacant properties ordinance. Residents can watch the virtual meeting.

items.title: Public comments on utility double poles
items.summary: The committee will discuss a resident's written comments about utility double poles.
items.skip_reason: An individual resident's communication; covered by the double poles discussion items

items.title: City process for tracking double poles and abandoned wires
items.summary: Public Works and Infrastructure staff will explain how the city tracks progress on removing double utility poles and abandoned wires, which cause hazards and damage trees.

items.title: Utility companies' plans for double poles and abandoned wires
items.summary: Representatives from Eversource, National Grid, Comcast, Xfinity, Astound and Verizon are asked to present their plans for removing double poles and abandoned wires around the city.
